description: The real dependency structure among the four solitaire components, determined by inspecting geometry/assemblies/solitaire.py and geometry/components/*.py directly during Sprint 6 — not assumed from call order.

sharedDerivedValueRelationships.note: Each independently calls this pure function; none reads another's built shape.
Both independently derive the same radius from stone.diameter and setting.prongDiameter.

conclusion: stone_reference is NOT required for the fuse step (only band, prongs, basket_support are), and none of the four component builders has a true data dependency on another's output. The current call order in build_solitaire_ring() is an arbitrary but stable ordering choice, not a topological-sort result — see docs/bible/08-alchemist/169-component-build-order.md.
